newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's puts Katokichi long-term debt under review.
newsitem.headline: Moody's puts Katokichi long-term debt under review.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had placed Katokichi Co Ltd's long-term debt under review for possible downgrade.

The action reflects Moody's increasing concern over Katokichi's weakening financial fundamentals, intensifying competition in the business areas in which the company operates, and increasing uncertainties in Katokichi's business strategies for the future, Moody's said in a statement.
It said Katokichi is one of Japan's leading frozen processed food makers.
The current rating of Katokichi's senior unsecured long-term debt is Baa3, Moody's said.
Moody's review will focus on Katokichi's ability to improve its financial fundamentals and its future strategies to expand market share in an increasingly competitive market, Moody's said.
